text:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — we need a concrete ingest contract from runtime so Console can ship per-model SLO panels (P50/P95/P99, TTFT, tokens/sec). Who owns fields and sampling? cc @Maria @Devon

Maria Gonzalez: I can take ownership of the contract doc. couple questions: do you want raw request events or pre-aggregated windows? also what's the expected cardinality (model_id x route x variant x region)?

Devon Patel: We can emit both. proposal: runtime emits raw request events with stable sample_key + per-node 10s pre-aggregates. pre-aggregates for tokens/sec, request_count, failure_count, and latency histograms. keeps TSDB load reasonable.

Alex Chen: Sounds good. Console needs these canonical fields so panels are deterministic. can you confirm the field names and types? and sampling semantics (deterministic hash so percentiles aren't skewed)?

Devon Patel: Yep — deterministic sampling by request_id. default sample_rate 0.5% for top-traffic routes, 5% for internal debug routes, and 100% for canaries. we'll include sample_rate metadata on aggregates.

Maria Gonzalez: Draft ingest schema (will open PR):
```json
{
  "timestamp": "iso8601 or unix_ms",
  "route_id": "string",
  "model_id": "string",
  "model_variant": "string",
  "region": "string",
  "hardware": "string", /* e.g. a100, h100, cpu */
  "quant_profile": "string",
  "request_id": "string (only on raw events)",
  "ttft_ms": "number",
  "latency_histogram": "hdr or psuedo-histogram blob",
  "p50_ms": "number (optional pre-agg)",
  "p95_ms": "number (optional pre-agg)",
  "p99_ms": "number (optional pre-agg)",
  "tokens": "int",
  "tokens_per_sec": "number (pre-agg)",
  "outcome": "string (success|error|timeout)",
  "routing_policy": "string (primary|fallback|replica)",
  "quota_bucket": "string",
  "sample_rate": "number (0..1)",
  "agg_window_s": "int (e.g. 10)"
}
```

Alex Chen: Nice — a few asks: make `routing_policy` enum explicit, add `is_dedicated_pool: true|false`, and a stable `route_fingerprint` (hash of route config) so dashboards group correctly even if route names change.

Samira Okoye: From Console UX: we prefer percentiles computed at ingest (p50/p95/p99) to avoid query-time heavy ops. but we also need histograms for re-compute. can we emit both? and include `display_name` for routes for human-friendly labels? :point_up:

Devon Patel: We can produce ingest percentiles from the node histograms and include them as pre-agg fields (p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms). histograms will be stored for 7 days at high fidelity, then rolled up. `display_name` ok as optional label.

Maria Gonzalez: retention/TSDB notes: raw events go to kafka topic `telemetry.raw.requests` (7d hot), pre-aggregates to `telemetry.agg.{10s,1m}` retained 30d, and long-term rollups (1h) to 365d. docs/PR will include retention table.

Alex Chen: How does quota impact metrics? we need `quota_state` (ok|throttled|overquota) and `applied_quota_policy` so Console can correlate latency regressions with throttles.

Devon Patel: adding `quota_state` and `applied_quota_policy`. note: throttled requests may not emit full tokens/sec since they never run; we'll include `attempted_tokens` vs `served_tokens`.

infra-bot: created telemetry schema PR #482: https://git.redwood/telemetry/pulls/482 (contains sample payloads + kafka topic names) :white_check_mark:

Console UX: will mock dashboard panels from schema tonight and share screenshots. questions for infra: what are expected cardinals? we need to set sampling per route to keep panels stable.

Devon Patel: expected cardinality: ~3k routes, ~120 models, variants x regions -> ~50k unique metric series peak. sampling will be route-configurable; default 0.5% global but teams can opt up. we'll add `sample_key` so sampling is deterministic per user/request.

Samira Okoye: timeline? Console wants to start wiring panels next week; can we get beta ingest (raw+10s pre-agg) by EOD Friday?

Maria Gonzalez: I'll finalize and merge schema PR today, Devon will enable topic and short-lived beta pipeline tomorrow. ping me if you need overrides for canaries.

Alex Chen: Great — thanks everyone. action items: Maria finalize PR, Devon enable pipeline & sampling config, Samira mock dashboards and list panel mappings to fields. follow-up thread for rollout UX (A/B vs canary vs 100%) later. :rocket:
